findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/NumberTheory/EllipticDivisibilitySequence.lean:70-71` lists both directions as TODOs; `normEDS_eq_aeval` at lines 118–120 quantifies only the function `normEDS b c d`.
findings.fix: Consistently say “sequence/function of the form `normEDS b c d`” until equivalence with `IsEllipticDvdSequence` is established.
findings.issue: Lines 29–44, 104–107, and 117 again call the constructed `normEDS` family every normalized EDS, contradicting the accurate limitation at lines 24–27.

findings.evidence: Lines 114–115 prove by `rfl` an equality whose RHS explicitly contains `normEDS (X B) (X C) (X D)`.
findings.fix: Describe it simply as the simp expansion of `universalNormEDS`, without claiming it hides the representation.
findings.issue: The `universalNormEDS_apply` docstring claims the lemma removes coupling to the explicit `X B`/`X C`/`X D` spelling, but its right-hand side exposes exactly that spelling and rewriting with it has the same result as unfolding.

summary: Several docstrings still overstate `normEDS` as representing every normalized elliptic divisibility sequence, and the application lemma’s stated abstraction benefit is inaccurate.
